newsitem.title: USA: U.S. carriers picked for Philippine cargo route.
newsitem.headline: U.S. carriers picked for Philippine cargo route.

text.p: United Parcel Service and Polar Air Cargo have been tentatively selected by the Transportation Department for new scheduled cargo service to the Philippines, the department said on Wednesday.
It said that under the mew U.S.-Philippine aviation accord, the United States can name two new all-cargo carriers. Now, the only cargo carrier is Federal Express Corp..
The department said that of the applicants, it determined that UPS could best compete with Federal Express in express and small package service as well as general freight service.
And it said it chose Polar because it determined that it offered the most single-plane service and the greatest amount of traffic between the two countries.
Also applying for the routes were Evergreen International Airlines, Northwest Airlines Corp. and World Airways Inc..
The department said objections to its tentative decision were due November 26, and answers to objections Decmber 6, with a final decision to follow.
